definitions.explanation: The act of putting theoretical knowledge or principles into practical use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{応用|おうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will apply this theory in practice.

examples.japanese: {応用|おうよう}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Application problems are harder than basic ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{応用|おうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The application of science changed society.

notes:
{応用|おうよう} refers to putting theory or knowledge into practical use. Can function as a noun or する verb.

USAGE AS VERB:
{応用|おうよう}する means to apply or put into practice.

COMPOUNDS:
- {応用|おうよう}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: application problem (in exams)
- {応用|おうよう}⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧: applied science
- {応用|おうよう}⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧: practical ability, applied skills
- {応用|おうよう}⟦{編|へん}→編：noentry⟧: advanced/applied section

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧:
{基礎|きそ} (basics, foundation) vs {応用|おうよう} (application). This pair is common in education and training: {基礎|きそ}⟦{編|へん}→編：noentry⟧ → {応用|おうよう}⟦{編|へん}→編：noentry⟧.

RELATED: ⟦{実用|じつよう}→実用：04216_jitsuyou⟧ (practical use) emphasizes everyday utility.
